basis: AA-ACA Benchmark v1 formal plan §4.5 and GUI backend blueprint B0
rule: A pilot view proves only its listed fields; a cluster is not GUI Gold until every selected Passive source and decisive target field has independent device readback and machine pixel QA evidence.

match_fields.cluster: cluster_id selects the candidate list; formal_pilot_datasets binds each dataset directory to its expected cluster-base.json cluster_id

conclusion_rules: A packet is supported only when its matched candidate and the capability entry are both supported, every required assertion is present, and every asserted field is covered; a pilot candidate is never promoted to supported.
A packet is text_only only when type is "text" and no capture spec is declared; a non-Text packet without a capture spec is missing.

A missing capture spec on a non-Text packet, an unbound source/app/view, an assertion outside the candidate or capability coverage, an unknown status, or a missing capability declaration all fail closed to missing.
This contract-level audit claims no device evidence and never marks a cluster GUI Gold.
